subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Many visitors used the app first, then joined a guide to ask deeper questions.”?
options: The app taught the school that communication is not improved by simply sending more information.
The guide realized the app gave basic information, while human guides gave conversation, humor, and local memory.
Students discovered that some programs were transparent, while others gave little information.
Then the guide explained that families once gathered around radios for news, music, and emergency information.
